title: 1. Generate first n prime numbers
explanation: A prime number is divisible only by 1 and itself. This program generates the first n prime numbers.

title: 2. Maximum of three numbers using conditional operator
explanation: The conditional operator (?:) selects the greatest of three numbers.

title: 3. Reverse digits using while loop
explanation: A while loop extracts digits and reverses their order using arithmetic operations.

title: 4. Calculate factorial of a number
explanation: Factorial is the product of all positive integers from 1 to a given number.

title: 5. Demonstrate the this keyword and private members
explanation: The this keyword refers to the current object. Private members can be accessed inside their own class.

title: 6. Rectangle area and perimeter using super and this
explanation: The super keyword accesses superclass members, while this refers to the current object.

title: 7. Abstract classes and methods
explanation: An abstract class can contain abstract and concrete methods. Subclasses implement abstract methods.

title: 8. Access modifiers in Java
explanation: Access modifiers control the visibility of classes, variables and methods.

title: 9. Sort elements of an array
explanation: An array stores multiple values. Sorting arranges its elements in ascending order.

title: 10. Matrix operations using multidimensional arrays
explanation: A two-dimensional array stores data in rows and columns, like a matrix.

title: 11. Constructor overloading
explanation: Constructor overloading means defining multiple constructors with different parameter lists.

title: 12. Copy constructor
explanation: A copy constructor creates a new object by copying values from another object.

title: 13. Demonstrate the final keyword in field declaration
explanation: The final keyword prevents a variable from being reassigned after initialization.

title: 14. Single, multilevel and hierarchical inheritance
explanation: Inheritance allows classes to acquire properties and methods from another class.

title: 15. Method overriding
explanation: Method overriding allows a subclass to provide its own implementation of an inherited method.

title: 16. Subclass constructor invoking superclass constructor
explanation: A subclass constructor uses super() to invoke its superclass constructor.

title: 17. Demonstrate final class
explanation: A final class cannot be extended by another class.

title: 18. Multiple try blocks and multiple catch exceptions
explanation: Separate try-catch structures can handle exceptions from different operations.

title: 19. Nested try statements
explanation: A nested try statement places one try block inside another try block.

title: 20. Exception handling using multiple catch blocks
explanation: Multiple catch blocks handle different exception types separately.

title: 21. User-defined exception using throw
explanation: A user-defined exception is created by extending the Exception class.

title: 22. Package access: same and external classes
explanation: Package access demonstrates how classes in a package can use accessible members.

title: 23. Import and access a user-defined package
explanation: The import statement allows a class to use a class from another package.

title: 24. Implementation of interfaces
explanation: An interface defines methods that an implementing class must provide.

title: 25. AWT program for string operations
explanation: AWT provides GUI components. This example performs string operations through a window.
output: Displays the entered text in uppercase in an AWT window

title: 26. Create multiple threads in Java
explanation: Multiple threads allow different tasks to execute concurrently.
output: Thread A and Thread B messages (order may vary)

title: 27. Implement thread using Runnable interface
explanation: The Runnable interface provides a way to define a task for a thread.

title: 28. String methods: equals, reverse and change case
explanation: String methods can compare, reverse and change the case of text.
output:
Equal: true
Reverse: avaJ
Uppercase: JAVA
Lowercase: java

title: 29. Concatenate strings using StringBuffer
explanation: StringBuffer allows strings to be modified and concatenated.

title: 30. Basic calculator operations
explanation: A calculator performs arithmetic operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
